description: This Java class implements file management operations (add, retrieve, remove) for static content such as images, CSS, JS, PDFs, and videos, using Infinispan cache for storage. It manages content per merchant store and handles cache node creation and deletion.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implements file management operations for static content using Infinispan cache, supporting add, retrieve, delete, and list operations for merchant-specific static files.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a static content file (image, JS, CSS, PDF, video) for a specific merchant store into the Infinispan cache.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store into the cache.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file for a merchant store from the cache.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists all file names of a specific static content type for a merchant store.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, effectively shutting down the cache operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the class instance.

methods.name: setRootName
methods.description: Sets the root node name for cache hierarchy.

methods.name: getRootName
methods.description: Gets the root node name for cache hierarchy.

methods.name: setCacheManager
methods.description: Sets the CacheManager instance used for cache operations.
